description:
Reborn as a Space Mercenary

Wake up, Commander. The Sector is burning.

Overview

Based on the manga

Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!

, now adapted for Starsector. You have awakened in the Persean Sector, a galaxy cut off from civilization and burning in endless war. But you aren't starting from scratch—you begin with your original ship, the Krishna, and your heroines by your side.

This mod adds a custom, story-driven Nexerelin start.

Disclaimer & Project Status (Very WIP):

This is the very first step of this project. I am not a traditional coder or sprite maker; I just dedicated my time to prompting and piecing this mod together using AI assistance. Any funds collected through tips will be used to cover AI subscription bills and, ultimately, to commission proper handcrafted sprites for the ships from human artists.

Features

The Krishna: Start the game in the cockpit of an overpowered, custom frigate now available with Custom Weapon too.The Reunion: Dock at any non-hostile station and click "Contact Crew" to spawn the Imperial ship officers Mimi, Elma, and Serena.Custom Imperial Ships: Your officers arrive piloting unique Imperial-class starships, plus an extra Imperial Vanguard escort & civilian support ships.Combat Chatter and Arma Amatura integration: now u can dock Krishna at any carrier also Sarena will have a Voice Clip.Imperial Surplus Market: added to Prism Freeport so you can buy the factions ships.Future Handcrafted Ship Sprite: Currently only Krishna and Black Lotus are Commissioned more ship, officer and station will be Commission once funding is secured.

Latest version new content: Version 0.0.4 is now live.
Some stat balancing, bug fixing and new Custom Weapons.

- Various ship Balancing on their Deployment point and ordinance Point
- Replace The ship in the Prism Freeport with its Bare Bone non-OP version 
- Add Custom Weapon for Krishna Human Version (PD, Laser and Torpedo)
- Fix Custom start officer Rank 
- Replace Custom start AI Krishna with Human Commission Krishna

have these installed for the mod to work:

Troubleshooting Note:

If Mimi, Elma, or Serena's portraits appear missing/broken when they spawn, press 'E' -> Intel -> Portrait Changer. Opening this menu once refreshes the game's cache and fixes the faces!

v0.0.2

- hullmods adjustment, Majority of the Hullmods are on Variant. the Build-in hull mods are only essentials so it wont interfere with other mods

    • Imperial Surplus Market: added to Prism Freeport so you can buy the factions ships.
    • Future Handcrafted Ship Sprite: Currently only Krishna and Black Lotus are Commissioned more ship, officer and station will be Commission once funding is secured.
